columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

columns.name: FirstName
columns.description: The first name of the customer.

columns.name: LastName
columns.description: The last name of the customer.

columns.name: product_with_the_highest_quantity
columns.description: The product with the highest quantity the customer has bought, with ties broken by the ascending order of the product name

columns.name: above_average_bought_quantity
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has bought more than the average quantity of customers who made a purchase, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: total_bought_quantity
columns.description: The total quantity of products the customer has bought, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: placed_order_for_product_id_1
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has placed an order for product ID 1, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: total_price_purchased
columns.description: The total price the customer has purchased, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: EmployeeID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the employee.

columns.name: FirstName
columns.description: The first name of the employee.

columns.name: LastName
columns.description: The last name of the employee.

columns.name: num_sales
columns.description: The number of sales the employee has handled, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: sold_over_20000_Touring_Blue
columns.description: Set to 1 if the employee has sold over 20000 units of the product "Touring-2000 Blue, 50", 0 otherwise.

columns.name: product_sold_most
columns.description: The name of the product that is most sold by the employee, with ties broken by the ascending order of the product name

columns.name: num_customers
columns.description: The number of customers the employee has served, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_amount_sold
columns.description: The total amount the employee has sold, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the product.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The name of the product.

columns.name: Price
columns.description: The price of the product.

columns.name: total_sale_price
columns.description: The total sale price of the product, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: sold_below_the_average_quantity
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product has been sold below the average quantity of all products, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: per_sold
columns.description: The percentage of the product sold in the total number of products sold.

columns.name: num_sold_by_Stearns_MacFeather
columns.description: The total quantity of products sold by the employee "Stearns MacFeather", replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: is_freebies
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product is freebies, 0 otherwise.
